newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks rise 2.12 pct on local retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks rise 2.12 pct on local retail buying.

text.p: Thai stocks rose 2.12 percent after about one hour of trade on Monday as local retail investors bought some large capitalised banking, finance and communication issues, brokers said.
The SET index, which has moved in positive territory since the market opened, rose 11.88 points to 573.07 by 0358 GMT as investors picked up cheap stocks following the market's recent sharp decline.
"The buying comes amid easing concerns about an attack on the baht by foreign speculators. A 50 billion baht support fund helped boost investor confidence," said a broker.
Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan announced on the weekend that commercial banks agreed to pool 50 billion baht for a fund aimed at helping the market.
The SET index moved down a bit and was trading 10.96 points higher at 572.15 by 0413 GMT.
